parameters.content:
## Receive & validate alert

Webhook POST /coldchain-alert takes the sensor alert, loads config, normalizes the fields into a ticket draft and rejects bad payloads with a 400.

## Client lookup & contract context

Looks up the client in Clients_SLA, merges contract tier, SLA hours and setpoints, and computes the temperature delta. Invalid payloads get a 400 reply.

## Defrost filter, severity scoring & duplicate check

Defrost spikes within +8C are logged as observations (202, no dispatch). Everything else is scored P1 / P2 / P3 with an SLA deadline, then checked against open tickets for the same client and equipment.

## Duplicate handling & technician matching

Repeat alerts on an open ticket are logged and acknowledged (lower row). New alerts load the roster and pick an AVAILABLE technician with the required certification, same zone first (upper row).

## Dispatch ticket & notify

Top row: create the DISPATCHED ticket, mark the technician ON_JOB, SMS the technician accept / decline / on-site / resolved links, alert the client dispatch desk, write the audit log and return 200. Bottom row: if no technician is available the ticket is logged UNASSIGNED, the on-call lead gets an SMS and the heartbeat keeps retrying.

## Technician callback intake

SMS links hit /tech-ack. The action is decoded, the ticket fetched, and the new status, timestamps and SLA result calculated. Stale links from another technician are rejected.

## Update state & confirm

Writes the new status to Tickets_Dispatch, frees or books the technician in Technicians, logs response time to the audit sheet and returns an HTML confirmation page.

## Heartbeat trigger & data load

Runs every 5 minutes, sets config (ack timeout 10 min) and loads all tickets and the technician roster.

## Evaluate SLA & apply updates

Flags SLA breaches, 50% warnings and unacknowledged or declined tickets. Reassigns to the next available technician or marks UNASSIGNED, then writes ticket and roster changes back to the sheets.

## Escalation SMS, audit log & voice call

Sends the escalation SMS (ops manager or technician), logs it to Escalation_Audit_Log, then phones the on-call lead for breaches, reassignments and no-technician cases.

## Workflow error alerting

Any failed execution texts the admin and writes a WORKFLOW ERROR row to the audit sheet. Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow in settings.

## Daily report data (08:00)

Pulls Tickets_Dispatch and computes 24h ticket counts by severity, average time to accept and to reach site, SLA met % and breaches.

## Report, snapshot & email

Builds the HTML report, saves a row to SLA_Daily_Snapshots and emails it to the ops address.

## ColdChain Breakdown Dispatch, Triage & SLA Engine

### How it works

This workflow dispatches technicians for cold-chain equipment alarms and enforces contract SLAs. An alert POSTed to a webhook is validated, matched to a client contract in Google Sheets, filtered for harmless defrost spikes, scored P1/P2/P3 with an SLA deadline and de-duplicated against open tickets. A certified, available technician (same zone first) is texted accept / decline / on-site / resolved links and the client dispatch desk is notified. A second webhook records technician responses. A 5-minute heartbeat escalates SLA breaches and 50% warnings and reassigns ignored tickets by SMS and voice call. Errors alert the admin and a daily 08:00 report is emailed. Every step is written to the audit log.

### Setup steps

- Create the Google Sheet with tabs Clients_SLA, Technicians, Tickets_Dispatch, Escalation_Audit_Log and SLA_Daily_Snapshots, and connect the Google service account.
- Connect Twilio and replace the placeholder phone numbers and base_url in Set Intake Configuration, Set Heartbeat Configuration and Setup Error Configuration.
- Connect Gmail and set report_email in Configure Report Settings.
- Activate the workflow, point alert sources at the /coldchain-alert production URL, and set this workflow as its own Error Workflow.

### Customization

Tune severity thresholds and SLA hours in Assess Alert Severity, the defrost rule in Check Defrost Cycle Status, ack_timeout_min and the 50% warning in the heartbeat code, and certification matching in Match Technician to Task.
